scenario: stuck inside a multi-story underground parking garage
part1_script: Underground concrete walls bounce sound like a megaphone. A single car horn will pull thousands straight down. You are trapped on Level B4. You have forty cars and twelve gallons of siphoned gas. At 3:15 AM, you block the spiral concrete ramp with three SUVs. Then you slash all six front tires. You wedge thick fire hoses across the stairwell doors. Nothing can pull the heavy steel handles down now. At 4:02 AM, the garage backup generator suddenly kicks on. Every overhead light flashes on with a deafening buzz. A massive horde smashes through the ramp barricade. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
last_line: A massive horde smashes through the ramp barricade. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
